title: Oil and parapetroleum workers' general assembly opposes CAMU salary deductions in Pointe-Noire
scope: General assembly of oil and parapetroleum workers reported by ACI; it made a demand about implementation of a state health-fund contribution, but public character and turnout are not specified.
threshold_50_evidence: ACI reports an assembly and an attached image caption but no attendance figure. It does not describe a public march or street gathering; ≥50 simultaneous attendees are unproven.

start_date.summary: ACI states workers expressed their opposition at a meeting on 5 December.

location.summary: The report places the meeting in Pointe-Noire.

organizer.summary: ACI attributes it to the intersyndical of oil-sector federations.

demands.summary: Workers opposed a planned 1.27% CAMU deduction from gross salary and asked for inclusive tripartite dialogue with government and employers.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Meeting is reported but its public character and attendance size are not specified.

state_response.summary: The account reports a request directed to government; it does not record government action at the meeting.

notes: This is an actual labor-policy meeting, not evidence by itself of a qualifying public mass protest. ACI reports a threat of future strike if the deduction were applied, not a strike during this episode.
open_questions: Was the 5 December assembly open/public or a workplace/union meeting?
How many workers were present simultaneously?
Was there a separate street demonstration?
Did the government or employers respond during or after this meeting?
Did the threatened January 2025 strike occur? It is outside this unit's period.
